samples.question: The picture shows a REFERENCE bar and two candidate bars labeled A and B. Every bar is divided by two vertical boundaries into three side-by-side sections: an indigo section on the left, a turquoise section in the middle, and an amber section on the right. In each bar add the widths of the left and middle sections, and add the widths of the middle and right sections; the REFERENCE's ratio is (left plus middle) over (middle plus right). Exactly one candidate reproduces this same composed ratio; the other candidate uses a clearly different one. Which candidate, A or B, reproduces the REFERENCE's composed ratio? Answer A or B.
